report_review.corrected_finding: Low preparation success does not erase equal-dose phase precision in this source model; it costs time. The report now distinguishes equal-time from equal-dose comparison.
report_review.scope: Scientific synthesis and numerical interpretation reviewed; delivery links/status and archive packaging are separate.

roadmap_mapping.request: Add G1, incoherent and stronger classical controls; plot G1/G2 and mixed response.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Five sources share a finite 32-cell geometry. Mixed activation coefficients are uncalibrated. Optical moments are separated from post-activation blur.

roadmap_mapping.request: Sweep loss, jitter, background and preparation success; charge attempts and distinguish dose/time budgets.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Nine cases and 140 sweep rows include asymmetry, fast jitter, blur, linear response, preparation and background. Pump/herald energy is unavailable; no full apparatus or arbitrary classical-optimum claim.

roadmap_mapping.request: Report harmonics, visibility, mean/peak G2 per photon, rate assumptions and finite-count uncertainty; independently check moments.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: The derived 90-row supplement closes the raw-moment reporting omission without adding independent trials. Original 540,000 Poisson realizations remain the finite-count evidence.

roadmap_mapping.request: Replace arbitrary coefficients with measured optics, material response, brightness, loss and development data.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: The roadmap explicitly permits stopping at sensitivity analysis when those inputs are unavailable. No feature-size, wafer-yield or throughput prediction is justified.

roadmap_mapping.request: Estimate a phase or geometry parameter at matched sample photon dose with loss, uncertainty and acquisition costs.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Phase only, both modes illuminate the object, local prior and global ambiguity separated, charged hybrid pilots. Known symmetric losses/reference and ideal photon-number resolution remain assumptions. Low preparation success costs time at equal dose; it removes the equal-time benefit in tested cases.

roadmap_mapping.request: Define field-amplitude signal and distinguish amplitude from intensity.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Effective Rabi-drive proxy; intensity proportional to squared drive only under fixed coupling. No watts, wavelength-specific response or pulse-energy conversion.

roadmap_mapping.request: Generate independent scheduled/telegraph records with precomputed instruments and retained hidden state.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: State retained across source changes; latent schedules used only for scoring. All four main pipelines and the independent review passed.

roadmap_mapping.request: Independent calibration/training/heldout splits, schedules and parameter settings.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Four independent finite calibration/training/evaluation pipelines; 229 non-colliding random-stream namespaces verified. All pipelines share nominal physical values; scenario counterfactuals vary specified sources/nuisances. No broad unknown-family identification claim.

roadmap_mapping.request: Test detuning, collection/loss, dark counts, dead time and afterpulsing separately and combined.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Declared13-case design includes abrupt emitter-detuning and detector changes. Abrupt detuning is not a full slow spectral-diffusion model. The main experiment retains all negative and nuisance-induced alarm results.

roadmap_mapping.request: Report bias/uncertainty, false alarms, delay, prediction and observation resources.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: First-alarm detection, full-record false alarms, honest restricted delay, predictive likelihood, bias/RMSE and descriptive hierarchical intervals are reported. Binary fluorescence counts are not incident photons; physical bandwidth/time calibration remains external. Same-record HMM/count analysis is not a complete optical photodiode comparison. Post-holdout prior-only control shows most source-case estimation improvement came from the fitted source prior; it is labeled descriptive, with unchanged main results.

roadmap_mapping.request: Choose compatible observable/platform and compare source changes against detector confounders.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Frequency surrogate: 23,040 held-out records, sessions, delay/FAR and C+C comparator. Amplitude surrogate: 6,656 held-out records, 13 cases, retained-state causal inference and nuisance controls. Neither validates a real sensor; the tested amplitude regime is a negative result.

roadmap_mapping.request: Obtain synchronized sensor/reference records and detector calibration in a laboratory.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: No real source, atomic sensor, detector or wafer data were acquired by these runs.

roadmap_mapping.request: Synthesize a coherent model and oracle for a scientifically defined inference task.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Static retained-instrument histories and full spatial process are constructed. A learned time-varying drive-schedule coherent oracle is not implemented. It is further local algorithm research, conditional on a useful identified diagnostic task and acceptable synthesis cost.

roadmap_mapping.request: Select an actual industrial monitoring point, compatible signal and process metric.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Visible/near-IR laboratory models do not automatically transfer to 193 nm DUV, CO2 drive lasers or 13.5 nm EUV. Need source and process experts with measured transfer data.

roadmap_mapping.request: Jointly infer coupling, detuning, dephasing, efficiency and drive, with uncertainty/degeneracy diagnostics.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Six cases and regenerated score vectors verified. Boundary solutions, local-Hessian limitations and global detuning aliases are findings, not failed completion. No globally calibrated confidence sets claimed.

roadmap_mapping.request: Fresh counterfactual datasets, rate-matched telegraph and stronger classical sequence models.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Fresh three-state HMM and two-state telegraph comparisons complete; arbitrary classical state-space families remain untested. Shared known physical structure is an information advantage, not a quantum computational speedup.

roadmap_mapping.request: Controlled pulse sequences and detuning scans to reveal temporal fingerprints.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Three known per-record controls break a structural sign symmetry. A separate completed diagnostic study changes drive over time with unknown step/telegraph schedules. General temporal pulse optimization and broad detuning scans were not performed.

roadmap_mapping.request: Test omitted physics: spectral diffusion, multimode, thermal photons, dead time, non-Markovian loss and cutoff.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Independent solver/cutoff and deadtime checks complete. Slow stochastic diffusion, thermal/multimode fields and non-Markovian environments remain optional local-model research; not laboratory blockers.

roadmap_mapping.request: Additional coherent bins, controlled approximations/noise and a useful comparison against exact classical inference.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Three bins ideal, one bin noisy, branch-state preservation and approximation bias audited. Strong classical recursion answers tested tasks efficiently. No useful crossover; no three-bin noise result.

roadmap_mapping.request: Fit appropriate fiber/lithography observable data without unsupported microscopic identification.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Synthetic fluorescence histories and literature context are not a physical source/defect dataset.

roadmap_mapping.request: Construct the actual 49-cell process with bounded approximation, coherent preparation/oracle and total resources.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: Both 389-qubit explicit QPY artifacts independently loaded; 563 count maps per circuit, actual wiring/uncompute and primitive costs checked. Independent FFT verifies four DP probabilities. Compact serialization unsupported; no 389-qubit state/noise/hardware simulation.

roadmap_mapping.request: Improve and assess original importance sampling with tuning costs, repeats and probability reference.
roadmap_mapping.scope_or_remaining_work: 12 million evaluation maps plus 80,000 pilot maps; original proposal undercoverage exposed and better frozen proposal tested.100 repeats do not prove universal interval calibration.

good_stopping_point: Finish and verify the declared finite studies, preserve negative and inconclusive outcomes, charge resources, and state model boundaries. This is not completion of every imaginable lithography or sensor research direction.
future_local_research: Slow stochastic spectral diffusion and its identifiability against coherent defects.
Thermal photons, extra cavity modes, non-Markovian loss and more realistic source/detector drift.
Arbitrary pulse/control optimization and richer classical state-space comparators.
Joint phase-and-loss inference, imperfect references/number detection and source-mode mismatch.
Structure-aware synthesis or learned time-varying schedule oracles, justified only by a useful task and comparative resource evidence.
Repeated pilot selections, further dose settings, calibrated correlated process models and optimized reversible arithmetic.
external_inputs: Defined source wavelength, measurand, sampling location, allowed tap and required noise bandwidth.
Measured optical coupling, geometry, source brightness/success, phase/reference stability and preparation/detection resources.
Detector efficiency, dark counts, dead time and afterpulsing under actual timing conditions.
Synchronized candidate-sensor and strong conventional-reference records under blinded independent interventions.
Wavelength-specific material response, development/blur, feature geometry and source-to-process transfer data.
api_decision: No additional IBM job is needed for the present stopping point. Hardware can test a justified shallow implementation question but cannot supply missing optical/material calibration.

drive_result_synthesis.interpretation: The tested low-count retained-state monitor does not establish useful prompt amplitude diagnosis. Detector artifacts create false source alarms. This limits the specified operating point, not every sensor.
drive_result_synthesis.prior_control: Post-holdout descriptive comparison. The same fitted source prior achieves step RMSE 0.11362168 versus observation-based 0.11250952. The small paired MSE gain is 0.000251494; other source-changing cases have worse observation-based RMSE than prior-only. No main data, fits or thresholds were altered.
drive_result_synthesis.future_requirements: Further acquisition/operating-point or nuisance-aware studies must use newly defined calibration and holdout records; no retuning away the preserved negative result.

bounded_completion_rationale: All seven studies in the continuation plan have completed their finite, testable local scope. Negative findings and unresolved identification are valid outcomes. Broader numbered-roadmap aspirations remain explicitly partial, optional local research or external-data work; completion does not assert exhaustive research or practical device viability.
delivery_scope: This archived receipt certifies bounded local study completion only. Final archive extraction/delivery readiness is recorded separately in completion_review.json and the delivery receipt.
